text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A bloody end of the year: Killing of 28 civilians in Ain Defla province and a bomb explosion in Algiers.
- The security situation at square one: massacre of 28 civilians.

- Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia defends his government performance saying the inflation rate fell to 16.5 percent at the end of 1996 against 29 percent at the end of 1995. He says 80 percent of foreign loans were devoted to investment.
- The government plans to rescue 400,000 jobs in the industrial sector over the next seven years through debt restructuring and eased bank interest rate to companies.
- President Liamine Zeroual to sign the state budget into law on Monday.
- Unbearable violence of every day: bomb explosion in Algiers and slaughter in Ain Defla.
